assets.ticket:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: premium mobile RPG inventory item icon, pumpkin pet choice ticket.
Primary request: one beautiful compact choice-ticket item, a warm orange enamel pumpkin emblem mounted on an ornate golden embossed metal-and-paper admission ticket, subtle teal gemstone and ribbon accents, elegant collectible fantasy game illustration.
Composition: single centered object, almost front-facing with very slight diagonal angle for charm, broad clean strong silhouette readable at 64 pixels, object fills about 80 percent of square canvas. Pumpkin emblem is plain segmented pumpkin with stem, NOT a face. A few crisp restrained gold leaf scrolls. Genuine fully transparent alpha background outside object.
Materials: rich orange enamel, warm antique polished gold edging, dark teal satin strip, ivory parchment in recessed ticket body, detailed painterly highlights with clear 2D game icon finish.
Constraints: no text, no lettering, no numerals, no logo, no watermark, no faces, no characters, no scene or ground, no simulated checkerboard. Do not include multiple variants.
assets.panel:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: production game UI nine-slice panel art for pumpkin pet choice dialog.
Primary request: ONE square front-facing ornate Halloween panel with an elegant narrow gold and bronze pumpkin-vine frame, very small orange enamel pumpkins restrained to corners, tiny deep teal gems. An ample quiet dark ink-green velvet central interior must cover at least 82 percent of width and height, almost flat and unobtrusive for later DOM text and approved character art. No artwork or medallion in the center. All large motifs confined to the outer corner regions.
Style: polished 2D fantasy RPG UI raster asset, crisply hand painted tactile metal, delicate bevel, refined not gaudy.
Composition: perfectly flat front orthographic panel, straight uniform thin horizontal and vertical edge rails suitable for nine-slice stretch; generously spacious center; symmetry, small external corner flourishes, 3 percent transparent outside padding. Square canvas. The center stays dark opaque velvet. Transparent alpha outside the panel silhouette, no background scenery.
Constraints: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no symbols, no logo, no watermark, no character faces, no mockup presentation, no extra panels or buttons. Crisp usable image frame, no large top crest, no pumpkin heads inside the central content area.
assets.button:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: production game UI nine-slice horizontal confirmation button plate for pumpkin pet choice dialog.
Primary request: ONE wide horizontal elegant confirmation button, width four times its height, ornate restrained warm gold and bronze edges with small pumpkin-vine ornament at far left and far right, tiny orange enamel and dark teal gemstone accents, spacious dark deep green velvet central field reserved for DOM text.
Style: polished 2D fantasy RPG UI raster asset, hand painted metal bevel and subtle texture, matches warm pumpkin orange/gold/teal theme.
Composition: front orthographic straight-on plate, broad straight top and bottom rails designed for nine-slice horizontal stretching, thin edges, decorative corners confined to leftmost and rightmost 12 percent, quiet empty central 75 percent, no symbol in center. Plate occupies maximum practical width, full silhouette visible, transparent alpha outside plate only.
Constraints: no text, no numbers, no lettering, no logo, no watermark, no faces, no character, no background scene, no checkerboard, no multiple assets, no mockup. Do not make circular badge; create wide horizontal plate.
